title: The zone transitions' lens flares: res/field/lens_flares/lens_flares.json
description: ARCID_FIELD_GOOUT_EFFECT_DATA (a/2/4/1), a FieldLensFlareEntry per transition (field_lens_flare.h), which FieldLensFlare_DecideForZoneTransit searches when the player goes from one zone into another in sunny weather or none, without fog, and FieldLensFlare_Create shows a lens flare of (field_goout_effect.c). tools/data/lens_flare_data.py packs it.

transitions.description: The transitions, searched in order; one that isn't here shows none. The field uses only the first 0x43

zone.description: The zone the player goes into (zoneId)

from_zone.description: The zone the player comes from (transitId)

effect_sets.description: The effect set of each season and time of day (effectSetIds)

set.description: An effect set, a row of LENS_FLARE_IDS (field_goout_effect_data.c), of whose lens flares one shows at random: 0 for none, 1 to 8 for lens flares 0 to 7, 9 for one of 0 to 3

times.description: The effect set of each time of day: day for the morning and the day, night for the night and midnight (FieldLensFlare_GetSubIndexForDayPeriod)
